hero.description: MealCare by Renurg Health brings ready-to-eat, medically supportive meals to the doors of eligible New Yorkers — at no cost — through New York's 1115 Medicaid Waiver Social Care Network.
hero.disclaimer: MealCare is not a Social Care Network or SCN provider. We operate as an approved vendor handling meal logistics, preparation, and delivery in coordination with SCN providers.
